events.description: Acquired partner's 75% ownership interest in four properties held in the RegCal, LLC partnership for a total purchase price of $88.5 million in April 2022, which are now consolidated
events.source_quote: During April 2022, we acquired our partner's 75% share in four properties held in the RegCal, LLC partnership for a total purchase price of $88.5 million, which are now consolidated. A single operating property remains within RegCal, LLC at June 30, 2022.

events.description: Sold the remaining two properties of the NYC partnership on May 25, 2022 and distributed the sales proceeds to members, with planned liquidation and dissolution of the partnership to follow
events.source_quote: On May 25, 2022, the NYC partnership sold the remaining two properties and distributed sales proceeds to the members. Liquidation and dissolution will follow final distributions.

events.description: Settled 984,618 shares subject to forward sale agreements under the ATM equity program in April 2022, receiving net proceeds of approximately $61.3 million
events.source_quote: In April 2022, the Company settled 984,618 shares subject to forward sales agreements and received proceeds of approximately $61.3 million, after approximately $3.3 million in underwriting discounts and offering expenses.

events.description: Repurchased 1,234,417 shares of Class A common stock for an aggregate purchase price of $71.9 million during June 2022 under the Authorized Repurchase Program
events.source_quote: We paid $71.9 million during June 2022 to repurchase 1,234,417 common shares through our Authorized Repurchase Program.

events.description: Declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.625 per share on August 2, 2022, payable on October 4, 2022 to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2022
events.source_quote: On August 2, 2022, our Board of Directors declared a common stock dividend of $0.625 per share, payable on October 4, 2022, to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2022.

events.description: Sold one operating property, two land parcels, and one development project interest during the six months ended June 30, 2022, receiving net proceeds of $136.4 million and recognizing net gains on sale of $106.2 million
events.source_quote: During the six months ended June 30, 2022, we recognized gains on sale of $106.2 million for three land parcel and one operating property.

events.description: Invested $6.1 million in an existing co-investment partnership to fund Regency's share of acquiring one operating property during the six months ended June 30, 2022
events.source_quote: We invested $11.5 million in our real estate partnerships during 2022, including: o $6.1 million to fund our share of acquiring one operating property within an existing co-investment partnership
